text:
Many schools around the world now teach in more than one language, and some people say that this is difficult for teachers. I largely agree, since multilingual education places considerable demands on staff, although these demands can be reduced with proper support.

To begin with, teachers must meet demanding language and preparation requirements. Staff must prepare materials in several languages, hold advanced language qualifications and adapt lessons for pupils at very different levels, all within the same working day. A science teacher required to deliver chemistry in a second language, for example, must first master the specialist vocabulary herself. Qualified teachers who are fluent in more than one language are also scarce, so schools may struggle to recruit enough of them, and existing staff face heavy workloads.

Furthermore, classrooms with mixed language levels complicate teaching and assessment. Some pupils speak the language of instruction fluently while others are only beginning, so teachers must explain concepts in several ways and design different tasks, which leaves less time for individual attention. Without extra training and support, this additional workload leaves many teachers exhausted and weakens the quality of lessons. However, the difficulty can be reduced. Governments can fund training and language courses for teachers, provide teaching assistants and shared materials, and limit class sizes. The educational and cultural benefits of multilingual education justify this investment, but it must not be left to individual teachers to cope alone.

In conclusion, multilingual education is difficult for teachers because of its workload and varied classrooms, but with training and resources the challenge is manageable.

analysis.type_vi: Agree / Disagree: 'multilingual education is difficult for teachers' → largely agree + giải pháp

plan.step: 1. Đề nói về khó khăn nên mọi lý do phải về GIÁO VIÊN
plan.think: Khác với đề 119, 199 (lợi ích cho học sinh), đề này hỏi khó khăn cho giáo viên. Mọi câu chủ đề phải có từ 'teachers'. Dùng lại ý nhược điểm của đề 199 làm lý do 1, thêm lý do 2 về lớp trình độ lẫn lộn.

plan.step: 2. Lý do 1 — yêu cầu ngôn ngữ và chuẩn bị
plan.think: Soạn tài liệu nhiều ngôn ngữ, bằng ngoại ngữ cao, thiếu giáo viên đủ chuẩn. Ví dụ giáo viên khoa học dạy hoá bằng ngôn ngữ thứ hai.

plan.step: 3. Lý do 2 — lớp trình độ lẫn lộn + giải pháp
plan.think: Giáo viên phải giải thích nhiều cách và thiết kế nhiều nhiệm vụ; ít thời gian chú ý từng em. 'However': nhà nước cấp kinh phí đào tạo, trợ giảng, tài liệu chung, giảm sĩ số.
